exclusion_reason: The engine lane is no longer a bare census label: the host fingerprints the asset's engine family, pairs it to the declared open-reimplementation build for that family (PrBoom+, EDuke32, QuakeSpasm, ScummVM, Sarien) under a rights boundary that keeps the user-owned asset held separate, and refuses a requested engine that contradicts the fingerprint as a mislabel. The benchmark stays red because no embedded Wasm engine build exists and no rights are attested, so the host produces a pairing plan but never reads the asset or runs anything, under the BPTK-002 corpus denominator.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the matched title runs on its Wasm engine with separated asset and the no-rights case is blocked.
expected_failing_assertion: The host produces a pairing plan but stays blocked because no Wasm build is embedded and no rights are attested, so nothing runs.
active_gate_evidence: test/engine.test.mjs asserts a fingerprinted asset paired to its reimplementation with the asset held separate, a mislabel refusal for a contradicting engine, the blocked-until-build-and-rights terminal state, an unfingerprinted asset pairing with nothing, and real-CLI reachability that never copies the asset.
procedure: Run the matched title on its Wasm engine build.
Assert asset load from storage with zero commingling.
Attempt a no-rights asset and assert the block.
pass_criterion: The title runs on its engine.
Asset stay separated and no-rights is blocked.
